en.headline: 1 own commit plus 6 automated; opened and commented on openchamber issue 4537
en.summary: On 2026-10-08 the user made **1 own commit** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, adjusting the daily CI cron to avoid the top of the hour and adding a push fallback trigger for this repo. That was accompanied by 6 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. On the issues side, the user opened issue #4537 in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows 'Provider not configured' while the Providers page shows an API key for it" and then commented on it twice more, bringing the day's issue activity to 3 entries on that single thread. A reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` arrived on the same issue, noting the cause was traced and marking it `fix-ready`, pointing out that the two surfaces resolve OpenCode Go credentials differently and that the mismatch is live on current main.

zh.headline: 本人 1 次提交加 6 次自动提交；新开并评论 openchamber 4537 号 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-08 当天，用户在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库完成了 **1 次本人提交**，调整了每日 CI 的 cron 以避开整点，并为该仓库增加了 push 兜底触发。此外还有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 产生的自动提交。当天没有 PR、代码评审、发布、星标或讨论活动。Issue 方面，用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开了 #4537，标题为 "[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows 'Provider not configured' while the Providers page shows an API key for it"，随后在同一 issue 上又评论了两次，当天该线程共 3 条 issue 活动。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 也在该 issue 上回复，指出原因已定位并标记为 `fix-ready`，说明两个界面解析 OpenCode Go 凭据的方式不同，且该不一致在当前 main 分支上仍然存在。
